sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASES: https://perctrax.bandcamp.com/album/one — both tracks from Perc & Barbosa's 2026-08-28 EP screened from track-specific label descriptions; One retained for its bass-heavy minimalist framework, sharp clicks, dislocated vocal hooks and deliberately sparse hi-hat pattern.

CURRENT / ADJACENT: https://perctrax.bandcamp.com/track/nostalgia — Shaun Moses's 2026-08-07 Perc Trax debut screened from its exact-track description; Nostalgia retained as an emerging-artist lead for the combination of Detroit-inspired pads and a solid kick/bass foundation.

RECENT CROSS-VOCABULARY: https://batutimedance.bandcamp.com/album/exhale-2 and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/batu-donato-dozzy-exhale — all eight tracks from Batu & Donato Dozzy's 2026-06-30 album screened; Spiral retained because the track-specific review attributes plodding kicks, gnarled acid bass, dubby hand percussion and a loping dancehall cadence.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://perctrax.bandcamp.com/album/aurifex-rex — all four tracks from Scalameriya's 2025-11-21 EP screened from exact-track label descriptions; Aurifex Rex retained for its glitched, stuttered vocal construction and constant-build framing.

BOUNDED QUERIES: September and August 2026 Bandcamp techno, broken-rhythm, polyrhythmic, syncopated, bass-heavy and adjacent-label result windows; exact Spotify identities intentionally left to the repository resolver.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 25 named tracks across four release/catalogue pages and bounded current-release result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 12 canonical identities, all active placement-specific rejections and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Runs 49–50 material and sources were not recycled.
The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and its two listener-protected handoffs remain untouched; every proposed placement follows the intact block.

Perc & Barbosa — Two, Batu & Donato Dozzy — Emergence / Drift / Off Axis / Swarm / Flicker / Exhale / Bloom, and Scalameriya — Psybernetix / It Stared Back / Perc Remix had useful exact descriptions but ranked below the four retained leads for this scan's selection-lens and post-trio hypotheses.
Recent search results from Vault, ALU, MEUK and other adjacent catalogues were screened but did not provide a stronger combination of exact-track behavioural evidence and a genuinely new source lane.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre category, BPM proximity, title or novelty. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Perc & Barbosa — One: exact-track label description names bass-heavy minimalist construction, sharp synth clicks, spaced dislocated vocal hooks and a sparse hi-hat pattern; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

2. Batu & Donato Dozzy — Spiral: track-specific review describes an acid-and-dub hybrid with hand percussion and a loping dancehall cadence; exact Spotify identity requires resolver verification and the reported 107 BPM is metadata only.
3. Scalameriya — Aurifex Rex: exact-track label description names a glitched, stuttered vocal and constant build; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

4. Shaun Moses — Nostalgia: exact-track label description combines Detroit-inspired pads with a solid kick/bass foundation and cross-set utility; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
